title: Predicted UFO hovers over Puharich family gathering

tellings.quote: like him, that Puharich's son and two or three of the cousins all saw this huge thing. It silently hovered over.

plain: Sometime between 1987 and 1989 in North Carolina, a huge object is said to have hovered silently over a family gathering of Andy Puharich, a scientist said to have tried to contact an alien council, after he had predicted it would appear. The researcher Greg Malatzi relays it from what a cousin of Puharich told him, saying Puharich's son and "two or three of the cousins all saw this huge thing," and links it to a family video. If true, it would mean a UFO came when it was called.
